title: Policies for information security
requirement: Information security policy is defined, approved by management, published, and reviewed at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.

title: Information security roles and responsibilities
requirement: Information security roles and responsibilities are defined and allocated to named roles according to organisational needs.

title: Threat intelligence
requirement: Information relating to information security threats is collected and analysed to produce actionable threat intelligence.

title: Information security in supplier relationships
requirement: Processes are defined to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier products and services.

title: Information security for use of cloud services
requirement: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services are established in accordance with the organisation's security requirements.

title: Information security incident management planning
requirement: Incident management responsibilities and procedures are planned and prepared, including reporting channels and defined response timescales.

title: ICT readiness for business continuity
requirement: ICT readiness is planned, implemented, maintained and tested against business continuity objectives and recovery time requirements.

title: Screening
requirement: Background verification checks on candidates for employment are carried out prior to joining, proportionate to the sensitivity of the information they will access.

title: Security awareness, education and training
requirement: Personnel receive appropriate information security awareness education and training, and regular updates to organisational policy, relevant to their job function.

title: Responsibilities after termination
requirement: Information security responsibilities that remain valid after termination or change of employment are defined, enforced and communicated.

title: Physical security monitoring
requirement: Premises are continuously monitored for unauthorised physical access.

title: Privileged access rights
requirement: The allocation and use of privileged access rights is restricted and managed, with periodic review of who holds them.

title: Secure authentication
requirement: Secure authentication technologies and procedures are implemented based on information access restrictions and the access control policy.

title: Information backup
requirement: Backup copies of information, software and systems are maintained and regularly tested in accordance with an agreed backup policy.

title: Monitoring activities
requirement: Networks, systems and applications are monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential security incidents.
